hints.content:
###Strategy

Let's use the data in the graph to find the height of this sponge when its age is $1$ year. Since the sponge grows at a constant rate, we can then write an equation to find its age ($a$) from its height ($h$).

###Unit rate and equation

[[☃ image 1]]

$a$ | $1$ | $\maroonE{\leftarrow \div 4}$ | $4$ | $8$ | $10$
:- | -: | -: | -: | -: | -:
$h$ | $2$ | $\maroonE{\leftarrow \div 4}$ | $15$ | $30$ | $45$

The sea sponges's height grows $2\,\text{cm}$ every $1$ year, so we can write an equation to find the height ($h$) at any age ($a$):

$h=2a$

And we can rewrite the equation so age ($a$) is by itself:

$a=\dfrac{h}{2}$
